# Glossary: the words of a story, and where they are in the suite

The words on the site's links (what a BA writes in a story) and the page class and method each leads
to. From the crawl: the header and footer links, links between pages, and the page types' names.

| Words in a story | Page class | How a test gets there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0` | CartPage | `navigateTo().cart()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Who We Are` | WhoPage | `navigateTo().who()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `What We Do` | ServicesPage | `navigateTo().services()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Our Accomplishments` | AccomplishmentsPage | `navigateTo().accomplishments()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Our Work` | OurWorkPage | `navigateTo().ourWork()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Blog` | BlogPage | `navigateTo().blog()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Contact Us` | ContactPage | `navigateTo().contact()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Peregrine Advisors` | HomePage | `navigateTo().home()` from any page, in a header dropdown |
| `Skip to Content` | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()`: its `#page` section (a link on the start page) |
| `SBA (8a) Certified` | Peregrines8aPage | `new WhoPage(page).open().click().goToPeregrines8a()` |
| `SBA 8(a) certified business` | Peregrines8aPage | `new ServicesPage(page).open().click().goToPeregrines8a()` |
| Home | HomePage | `new HomePage(page).open()` |
| Contact | ContactPage | `new ContactPage(page).open()` |
| Accomplishments | AccomplishmentsPage | `new AccomplishmentsPage(page).open()` |
| Cart | CartPage | `new CartPage(page).open()` |
| Who | WhoPage | `new WhoPage(page).open()` |
| Services | ServicesPage | `new ServicesPage(page).open()` |
| Our Work | OurWorkPage | `new OurWorkPage(page).open()` |
| Blog | BlogPage | `new BlogPage(page).open()` |
| Article | ArticlePage | `new ArticlePage(page).open("srkperegrineadvisorscom")` |
| Tag | TagPage | `new TagPage(page).open("BSA%2FAML")` |
| Peregrines8a | Peregrines8aPage | `new Peregrines8aPage(page).open()` |
